![Safari Park Lunar New Year 2024](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/styles/hero_with_nav_gradient/public/hero/lunar-new-year_lp-hero-image_sp22.jpg?itok=Lm_Y6A8X)

February 1, 2025

Celebrate good fortune this Lunar New Year, a holiday recognized throughout many East and Southeast Asian countries. This year is the Year of the Snake, and those born during this zodiac year are known for being intuitive, thoughtful, and loyal. This year is represented by the wood snake, symbolizing playfulness, elegance, and transformation.

Join us for Lunar New Year and Wild Weekend: Asia at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park on Saturday, February 1, 2025. Discover fun activities for the whole family and be inspired by the conservation work you make possible through our [Asia Conservation Hub](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/conservation-hub/asia). Together we’re making a difference for vulnerable and endangered Asian wildlife, including Sumatran tigers, and their dynamic ecosystems. Good wishes and hope for the future await you at the Safari Park.

_The San Diego Zoo is hosting Lunar New Year and Wild Weekend: Asia events on February 1–2, 2025. For more information on the Zoo’s celebration, please visit_ [_this page_](https://zoo.sandiegozoo.org/lunar-new-year) _._

## Activities

![people hanging wishes on a tree](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/wish_tree_lny_23_thum.jpg)

### Lunar New Year Wishes and Good Fortune

- 10 a.m.–3 p.m.
- Tull Family Tiger Trail

Share your wish for wildlife and hang it on our wishing tree. Then receive a red envelope with a gift inside, a celebrated tradition for Lunar New Year.

![Kids doing crafts](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SP25_AT7150_lunar-new-year-snake-craft_web-thumb_668x540.jpg)

### Year of the Snake Activity

- 10 a.m.–3 p.m.
- Tull Family Tiger Trail

Create and take home a snake craft in honor of the Year of the Snake.

![tiger](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/wcs_tiger_lny_23_thum.jpg)

### Ask a Wildlife Care Specialist

- Select times from 10 a.m.–3 p.m.
- Tull Family Tiger Trail

Meet with our wildlife care experts and discover fascinating insights about iconic Asian species while you learn more about the incredible conservation work you support through our [Asia Conservation Hub](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/conservation-hub/asia).

![Lunar New Year Baos and food](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SP25_AT7150_lunar-new-year-flavors-of-lunar-new-year_web-thumb_668x540.jpg)

### Flavors of Lunar New Year

- 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
- Thorntree Terrace, Macan Market

From January 29–February 12, enjoy flavorful specialties and unique Lunar New Year menu offerings.

![Tiger standing over a calm pond](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SP24_AT-4945_lunar-new-year-flavors-of-be-a-wildlife-ally_web-thumb_668x540_0.png)

### Be a Wildlife Ally

As an ally, you’re making a difference for vulnerable and endangered wildlife through our [Asia Conservation Hub](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/conservation-hub/asia). Your visits to the Safari Park and continued support help save, protect, and care for wildlife throughout Asia and across the globe.

[Become an ally for wildlife today.](https://secure3.convio.net/sdzoo/site/Donation2;jsessionid=00000000.app30131a?idb=1367869548&df_id=15689&mfc_pref=T)

We’re celebrating YOU with **Member September!** Every day in
September, members can join us at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park for exclusive member perks. You make it possible
to achieve our vision of a world where all life thrives, and we’d like to show our gratitude to our favorite
allies for wildlife—you! We can’t wait to see you there.

**Member September Benefits:**

- [Member Early Hours](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership/early-hours-current-renew) every Saturday and Sunday in September _(Excludes memberships with blockout dates)_
- Bonus Member Early Hours on Monday, September 1, in honor of Labor Day _(Excludes memberships with blockout dates)_
- Double [Wild Perks](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership/wild-perks) ℠ (10%, 20%, 30% or 40% depending on your level of membership) \*some restrictions apply
- FREE parking for ALL members, including San Diego Resident members and San Diego Resident Premium members
- Free Carousel rides for Wildlife Explorer members
- Other surprise and delight giveaways throughout the month!
- Special wildlife encounters every Saturday and Sunday!

| Member Level | Regular Savings | Member September |
| --- | --- | --- |
| San Diego Resident & San Diego Resident Premium | 5% | 10% |
| Wildlife Protector, Wildlife Protector Premium, Wildlife Supporter, & Wildlife Guardian | 10% | 20% |
| Wildlife Champion, Wildlife Associate, President’s Associates, President’s Partners, & Circle of Friends | 15% | 30% |
| President’s Patrons & President’s Ambassadors | 20% | 40% |

San Diego Resident members and Wildlife Protector members, [upgrade your\\
membership](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership-current) to experience all Member September benefits at the Safari Park.

_\*Only valid for safaris occurring in September. Some restrictions apply._

![condor flying in show](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/school_programs_hero.png)

Classes Available to Grades K–5 in Title 1 schools in the following districts: Alpine Union, Cajon Valley, Chula Vista, Coronado, Dehesa, Jamul-Dulzura, Lakeside, La Mesa/Spring Valley, Lemon Grove, Mountain Empire Unified, National Elementary, San Diego Unified, Santee, San Ysidro, and South Bay Union.

**For more information about any of these programs, please visit bookeo.com/sdzed-programs, or for more information, please email** [**EducationZoo@sdzwa.org**](mailto:EducationZoo@sdzwa.org) **.**

##### For Kindergarten–Grade 1 classes at Title I schools in San Diego County

#### San Diego County Students

Blending social and emotional learning, and Next Generation Science Standards, this two-part program includes a visit to your classroom and a field trip to the Zoo for your class, to inspire empathy for wildlife. Students will learn what animals need to survive, what body parts help with survival, and will be able to commit to at least one empathy-related conservation action. Bus transportation reimbursement is provided.

##### For all Grade 2 classes in San Diego County

#### Habitat Heroes

For over 50 years, the San Diego Zoo has offered a free field trip to all second-grade classes in San Diego County that includes an up-close wildlife encounter and a guided bus tour of the Zoo. This NGSS-aligned program lets students be scientists and discover the variety of plants and animals from habitats here in San Diego and around the world. Students are challenged to make observations, discover patterns, and compare wildlife across habitats.

> San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance is an international, nonprofit conservation organization with two front doors. We integrate wildlife health and care, science, and education to develop sustainable conservation solutions. Conservation is at the heart of everything we do. And it starts with that connection we make with people and wildlife every day. Because when wildlife thrives, all life thrives.

## Be a Wildlife Ally

We can't do it alone! Our supporters play a crucial role, and we need dedicated partners like you. Join the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance by becoming a member, help fund conservation projects, volunteer your time and knowledge, or partner with us to sustain conservation efforts worldwide. Your support makes a world of difference.

- [Membership ▸](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership)
- [Donate ▸](https://sdzwa.org/donate)
- [Volunteer ▸](https://zoo.sandiegozoo.org/jobs/volunteer)

## Discover

A world of fun and facts for wildlife explorers and teachers awaits on San Diego Zoo Wildlife Explorers. There are great reading options for both youths and adults in the works of San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Press, and many opportunities to explore interactive web-based training courses on Academy. Our Education programs offer a wide range of wildlife experiences, from amazing Summer Camps to learning adventures for all ages—and anyone with a computer or smartphone can join us to make a difference in ongoing conservation work through our Community Science programs.

Any Day's Hours

![Directions](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/body_image/Plan%20Your%20Visit-Direcions%20%26%20Parking.jpg)

### Directions

15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, California 92027-7017

Directions from the NORTH (southbound):

From Interstate 5 (Orange County, Los Angeles), take the State Route 78 East exit at Oceanside, proceed east to Interstate 15 South, exit at Via Rancho Parkway (Exit 27) and follow the signs to the Park. From Interstate 15 (Riverside), exit at Via Rancho Parkway (Exit 27) and follow the signs east to the Park.

Directions from the SOUTH (northbound):

From State Route 163 (downtown San Diego, Mission Valley) proceed to Interstate 15 North to the Via Rancho Parkway exit (Exit 27). Go east and follow signs to the Park. From Interstate 5 or 805 (Mexico), proceed to State Route 163, then to Interstate 15 North, and then exit at Via Rancho Parkway (Exit 27). Follow signs east.

Directions from the EAST (westbound):

From Interstate 8 (Imperial County, Arizona) take Interstate 15 North to the Via Rancho Parkway exit (Exit 27). Follow the signs east to the Park.

Public Transportation

For more information about bus and train schedules, please call 511 (San Diego's traffic and transit information service) or visit [gonctd.com.](http://www.gonctd.com/)

![Parking lot](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/body_side_image/parking-park2x.jpg)

### Parking

General parking (automobiles and motorcycles): $20 per vehicle per day. Oversized Vehicle parking: $55. Preferred parking: starting at $45. First come, first served; there are no in and out privileges.

As of January 6, 2026, all San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance adult members receive complimentary parking at the Safari Park by showing their valid membership card upon arrival at the parking booth.

![Hand holding a phone showing the San Diego Zoo Safari Park app](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/body_image/park_app_promo_thumb.png)

### San Diego Zoo Safari Park App

![park app icon](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/inline-images/app_icon_0.png)

Visiting the Park has never been easier, with the San Diego Zoo Safari Park app! Discover dining, activities, and more with the GPS-enabled map. Get ready for your visit by importing tickets and memberships to the digital wallet, adding your must-see wildlife to the day planner, viewing today's schedule, and much more.

### Guest Services

Our Guest Services office is located in the heart of Safari Base Camp, left of Safari Excursions at locator signpost 2.

Open daily to closing.

For information on the services and assistance we provide our guests on Safari Park grounds, [click here.](https://sdzsafaripark.org/guest-services)

![safari park front entrance](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/body_side_image/DGT1256_SP25_WEB_GuestsWithDisabilities_Tile_826x656%402x.jpg)

### Guests with Disabilities

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park welcomes all guests. We have several services to help guests with disabilities enjoy their visit. The Safari Park provides special parking, restrooms, and access to shows, tour buses, and exhibits for guests with disabilities. Please note there are steep grades in parts of the Safari Park. A complimentary ADA shuttle service operates inside the Safari Park for guests with mobility-related disabilities. Guests who use mobility assistive devices may also refer to the  map for ADA pathways and elevators.

For full guest disability services and policies,

[click here.](https://sdzsafaripark.org/guests-disabilities)

[Click here to download our Accessibility Map (PDF)](https://sdzwa.org/park-ada-map-print)

![Rex's Roar bronze lion in front of San Diego Zoo](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/body_image/plan_your_visit_guest_services%20%281%29.jpg)

### San Diego Zoo

2920 Zoo Drive, San Diego, CA 92101

The San Diego Zoo is the Safari Park's sister park to the southwest in San Diego. Distance between the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park is 35 miles. Please allow 45 minutes to 1 hour travel time.

[Purchase a two-park pass here](https://zoo.sandiegozoo.org/tickets)

# Professional Speaker Request

Looking to have a San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance professional speak with your group?

We're happy to match speakers with interested groups when possible. As a not-for-profit organization, we charge a speaker fee, which helps offset our costs and funds our mission. The minimum fee is $400 for a nonprofit organization or $600 for a for-profit organization, for one hour, and does not include a wildlife presentation or filming/recording fees. If your group is interested, please complete this [SPEAKER REQUEST FORM](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/speaker-request-form), and we will contact you.

# Program Advisements

## **Safari Park Flightline Program Advisements**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027

**Check-In:** 15 minutes prior to departure at the Safari Excursions, located adjacent to Thorntree Terrace Restaurant in Safari Base Camp (map coordinate Signpost 2).

**Program Requirements:**

**Minimum Ages**

Must be at least 8 years old. No exceptions.

Children ages 8 to 15 must be accompanied by a paid parent or guardian 18 years or older who must attend the entire Flightline experience. For participants under age 18, the liability waiver must be completed on site by a parent or legal guardian at the check-in.

**Adult/Child Ratio:** Maximum of 3 children ages 8 to 15 per adult.

**Weight**: Participants must weigh between **60** and **275** pounds and fit comfortably in the harness. No exceptions. Participants will be weighed at check-in.

**Height:**  All participants must meet the minimum height requirement of 48” (4 feet) tall. No exceptions.

**Footwear**: Secure, closed-toed shoes are required.

**Other Considerations**:

- Food or drink are not permitted on the tour.

- No alcohol may be consumed by a participant, prior to taking a Flightline Safari.

- Long hair must be tied back and loose accessories removed

- No loose items may be taken on tour, this includes wigs, hats without an under-chin strap, cameras without a strap, selfie-sticks, cameras with detachable camera lenses or lenses that extend further than 2-3 inches from the camera body, cellphones, purses, or bags.

- Storage & personal item transport available for small to medium sized bags and other loose items, no large bags or open containers.

- Sunglasses are recommended, as long as they fit securely on the wearers’ face.

- Guests must be able to climb and descend stairs without assistance.

- Restrooms are not available during the tour.

- To participate in Flightline Safari, each participant must complete a liability waiver and understand and follow instructions in English.

- This tour operates in most weather conditions and is subject to cancelation if weather conditions are deemed not safe

**Admission:**

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival.

**Change/ Cancellation:**

Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.

Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

Flightline is an all-weather event; however, the San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, and/or safety concerns.

For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods are not permitted.  Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

For the health and safety of wildlife, service animals are not permitted on this tour due to the sensitive nature of these animals and the restricted access of these habitats and buildings.

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed. Final decisions regarding viewing opportunities rest with the tour guide to ensure the best possible guest experience and animal welfare._

_Feeding and/or touching wildlife is not offered or permitted. Tours routes are subject to change based on wildlife care needs and other factors._

# Program Advisements

## **Safari Park Behind-the-Scenes Safaris Program Advisements**

**The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027**

**Check-In:** All Behind-the-Scenes Safaris check in 15 minutes prior to departure at Safari Excursions, located adjacent to Thorntree Terrace Restaurant in Safari Base Camp (map coordinate Signpost 2).

**Minimum Ages:**

- Lunar New Year- Wildlife of Asia
- Born to Be Wild
- Discover Africa
- Passport Into the Wild
- Saving Giants
- Walkabout Australia
- Wild Cat Adventure

**Ages 3 and older**.

Children 15 years old and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Limit of 2 children per adult per group. All tour participants require a ticket, regardless of age.

- Mission Wildlife Rescue!
- Wildlife Awareness Days

**Ages 8 and up.**

Children 15 years old and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Limit of 2 children per adult per group. All tour participants require a ticket, regardless of age.

- Sips on the Savanna
- **Ages 21 and older.**

Guests will be required to show ID or proof of age at check-in.

Sips on the Savanna may be cancelled up to 48 hours prior due to insufficient enrollment.

**ALL Behind-the-Scenes Safaris**

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival.

**Change/Cancellations:**

Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.

Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

Some walking is required during safaris.

Behind-the-Scenes Safaris are an all-weather event; however, during periods of inclement weather please call 619-718-3000 to check the status of your tour. The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you for a later Behind-the-Scenes tour.

For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted.  Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

Strollers and child car seats are not permitted on the cart. For the health and safety of wildlife, service animals are not permitted on this tour due to the sensitive nature of these animals and the restricted access of these habitats and buildings.

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed. Final decisions regarding viewing opportunities rest with the tour guide to ensure the best possible guest experience and animal welfare._

_Feeding and/or touching wildlife is not offered or permitted. Tours routes are subject to change based on wildlife care needs and other factors._

# Program Advisements

## **Butterfly Jungle Program Advisements**

**The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027**

**Check-In:** Butterfly Jungle Safari check-in is 10 minutes prior to the safari at the Butterfly Jungle Safari Entrance, located near the Rainforest Aviary.

**Late Arrivals:** We will do our best to accommodate guests up to 15 minutes past their reserved time. Beyond 15 minutes, arrivals cannot be accommodated; original tickets are non-refundable, and a new purchase is required.

**Minimum Ages**

All ages may join Butterfly Jungle Safari. All guests over 1 year of age require a paid ticket. Infants under the age of 1 are free and require a complimentary infant pass, available on grounds at the Butterfly Jungle ticket booth, first come, first served. A paid adult must accompany children ages 15 and younger. Limit of 5 children per adult, per group.

No restroom available within the experience.

No food or drink except for water or other closed containers.

No outside plant material is allowed inside Butterfly Jungle.

No large or bulky camera equipment; no tripods except when used as monopods.

For butterfly health and safety, photo extension poles ("selfie sticks") must be stowed away during safari.

Strollers are not permitted inside the Hidden Jungle; stroller parking is available outside of Hidden Jungle.

This is an all-weather event.  Butterfly Jungle Safari is not cancelled for inclement weather; please plan accordingly. Refunds and rescheduling opportunities are not available for inclement weather.

_A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival._

**Change/Cancellations:**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to animal health and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation for these reasons, efforts will be made to reschedule you on a later tour.

# Program Advisements

## **Safari Park Roar & Snore Program Advisements**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027

[**Roar & Snore Preparation List and Guest Information**](https://sdzsafaripark.org/roar-snore-preparation-list-guest-info)

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival.

**Check-In**

**Roar & Snore Check-In:** Check-in takes place from **4:15 to 5:00 PM** in the Preferred Parking section at the top of the guest parking lot. Guests should drop off their luggage at the Roar & Snore check-in booth and then proceed to Safari Excursions to complete the check-in process. The check-in area is marked by a large “Roar & Snore Safari” sign

_**SUPREME**_ **Roar & Snore Check-in:** Campers will drop-off luggage in the Preferred Parking section at the top of the guest parking lot at **3:45 PM**, then will be directed to Safari Excursions to complete their check-in by 4:00 PM.

**Check-Out**

**Roar & Snore Check-Out:** Camperswill be escorted out to the parking lot by 9:30 AM to receive their luggage. They may then re-enter the Safari Park at their leisure.

_**SUPREME**_ **Roar & Snore Check-Out:** at 10:30 AM at the check-in location, where guests will receive their luggage back from staff. They may then re-enter the Safari Park at their leisure, with their tickets and hand-stamps or membership cards.

**Minimum Ages**

**Adults:** 21 and over only

**All Ages:** All Ages programs require at least one adult, ages 18 and older, per tent.

**Supreme:**  Ages 8 and up only

**Girl Scouts:** Girl Scouts nights are for Girl Scouts ages 5 and older, with adult chaperones. Girl Scouts must book a designated Girl Scout night. There must be at least one adult chaperone per tent.

**School & Youth:** School & Youth Nights are for students in grades 3 through 12, with adult chaperones, as well as youth groups such as YMCA, Boys & Girls Clubs, FFA, 4-H, Cub Scouts, Church Groups, etc.  There must be at least one adult chaperone per tent.

**Adult-Child Ratio for School & Youth Nights:** Adults may not attend without students or youth group members.  The number of adults may not exceed the number of student/child/youth participants. There must be at least one adult chaperone per tent. Students/youth may not sleep in a tent without an adult chaperone. A chaperone is defined as an adult 18 years of age or older and no longer a high school student. Any student, regardless of age or maturity, is not considered a chaperone and will not satisfy the ratio requirement. Adults who have not been designated by the school/teacher/organization as an official chaperone may not attend. Siblings are permitted only if they are in grades 3 – 12 (i.e., no siblings younger than third grade).

**Changes and Cancellations:  All Ages and Adult Nights**

Reservations may be changed up to 30 days before the program with no Administrative Change Fee. Less than 30 days, changes not permitted.

Cancellations received 30 days before scheduled program are subject to a $50 Cancellation Fee. Less than 30 days, payment is non-refundable.

**Changes and Cancellations:  Girl Scouts and School / Youth Nights**

$100 Deposit paid at initial booking is non-refundable.

Any balances are due in full 30 days prior to program along with actual number of participants.

Reservations may be changed up to 30 days before the program and will be subject to a $25 Administrative Change Fee. Less than 30 days, changes not permitted.

Cancellations received 30 days before scheduled program will forfeit deposit paid. Less than 30 days, payments are non-refundable.

**Additional Information for All Roar & Snore Sleepovers**

Some walking is required during tours.

Roar and Snore Safaris are an all-weather event; however, during periods of inclement weather, the San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a program due to inclement weather, animal health, insufficient enrollment and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you for a later, applicable Roar & Snore date.

For the safety of our wildlife and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted.  Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

For the health and safety of wildlife, service animals are not permitted in all areas during this program, due to the sensitive nature of these animals and the restricted access of these habitats and buildings.

The Safari Park hosts many private events that may take place near the campsite during Roar & Snore, some lasting as late as 10pm. Please be aware that there may be music or sounds of excitement and celebration during these events. The Safari Park works on mitigating noise bleed, but event venues are outdoors, and the valley may carry sound.

## **Safari Park Ultimate Safari Program Advisements**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027

**Check-In:**15 minutes prior to departure log ring outside the Safari Park entrance.

**Minimum Ages**

All ages welcome. Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult.

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is included.

**Change/Cancellation:**

Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.

Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $200 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to program, payment is non-refundable.

Ultimate Safari is an all-weather event; however, the San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, and/or safety concerns.

For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted.  Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

Strollers and child car seats are not permitted on carts or trucks. For the health and safety of wildlife, service animals are not permitted on this tour due to the sensitive nature of these animals and the restricted access of these habitats and buildings.

# Program Advisements

## **Safari Park Wildlife Safari Program Advisements**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027

**Check-In:** All Wildlife Safaris check-in 15 minutes prior to departure at Safari Excursions, located adjacent to Thorntree Terrace Restaurant in Safari Base Camp (map coordinate Signpost 2).

**Wildlife Safari:**

Ages 3 and older. Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Maximum 3 children ages 15 and younger per adult.

**Deluxe Twilight and Twilight Wildlife Safaris:**

Ages 6 and older. Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Maximum 3 children ages 15 and younger per adult.

**Sips on Savanna: Cocktail, Mimosa and Wine Wildlife Safaris:**

Ages 21 and older. Guests will be required to show ID or proof of age at check-in.

Cocktail and Wine Safaris may be cancelled up to 4:00 p.m. the day prior due to insufficient enrollment.

Mimosa Safari may be cancelled up to to 48 hours prior due to insufficient enrollment.

**All Other Wildlife Safaris:**

Ages 6 and older.  Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult.  Maximum 3 children ages 15 and younger per adult.

**ALL Wildlife Safaris:**

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival.

**Change/Cancellations:**

Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.

Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

Wildlife Safaris are an all-weather event; however, during periods of inclement weather please call 619-718-3000 to check the status of your tour. The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, insufficient enrollment and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you for a later applicable Wildlife Safari tour.

Strollers and child car seats are not permitted on the truck. For the health and safety of wildlife, service animals are not permitted on this tour due to the sensitive nature of these animals and the restricted access of these habitats and buildings.

For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted.  Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed. Final decisions regarding viewing opportunities rest with the tour guide to ensure the best possible guest experience and animal welfare._

_Feeding and/or touching wildlife is not offered or permitted. Tours routes are subject to change based on wildlife care needs and other factors._

# Program Advisements

**Safari Park Wildlife Trek Program Advisements**

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is located at 15500 San Pasqual Valley Road, Escondido, CA 92027

**ALL Wildlife Trek Safaris**

- A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry.  Safari Park parking is not included and is paid upon arrival.

**Check-In:** Wildlife Trek Safaris check-in 15 minutes prior to departure at Safari Excursions, located adjacent to Thorntree Terrace Restaurant in Safari Base Camp (map coordinate Signpost 2).

**Minimum Ages**

- **Walking with Elephants** \- All ages may join. Children 15 years old and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Limit of 2 children per adult per group.
- **Sip & Stroll: Elephant Valley** \- Minimum Age: 21 years. Photo ID required at time of check-in.

**Mobility -** Guests with mobility considerations should please call **(619) 718- 3000** to inform us of their needs.

- Mobility devices are permitted.
  - **Walking with Elephants -** This tour involves about 60 minutes of walking, mostly on established pathways with moderate slopes.
    - Strollers are permitted
  - **Sip & Stroll: Elephant Valley -** This tour involves about 90 minutes of walking, mostly on established pathways with moderate slopes.

**Other Considerations**

- Snacks and drinks are permitted. Water is recommended. Guests may be asked to put food and drinks away/aside temporarily in certain wildlife areas.
- Service animals are permitted. Some areas may be sensitive or restricted to service animals; tour routes will be adjusted accordingly.
- Guests are advised to use the restroom before the tour begins.
- Comfortable attire, walking shoes, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat are recommended.
- For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted.

**Change/Cancellations:**

Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.

Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you on a later tour.

_Feeding and/or touching wildlife is not offered or permitted. Tours routes are subject to change based on wildlife care needs and other factors_

# Protecting California’s Butterflies

[Butterfly Jungle](https://sdzsafaripark.org/butterfly-jungle)

San Diego County is a biodiversity hotspot, home to a dazzling array of wildlife—including nearly 150 butterfly species! Some of these winged wonders are threatened, and it’s up to us to create a world where they can thrive. The western monarch population is in an especially precarious state, having dropped by more than 95 percent since the 1980s.

San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance is committed to protecting wildlife in our own backyard through our Southwest conservation hub, including monarchs and threatened Quino checkerspot butterflies. You can join us in securing their future.

## Be a wildlife Ally

By supporting San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, you are our ally in saving and protecting California’s butterflies and other wildlife worldwide.

- [Donate](https://secure3.convio.net/sdzoo/site/Donation2;jsessionid=00000000.app367a?15706.donation=form1&df_id=15706&mfc_pref=T&NONCE_TOKEN=581EE3AE6F1F5E0D49D702767F7A472B)
- [Adopt a Butterfly](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/adopt/butterflies)

## Take Action

Ask your representatives to support legislation that protects threatened monarch butterflies.

- [Contact your representative](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/take-action/habitat-degradation)

# Safaris

### Safari Excursions

Your safari adventures and special experiences begin at this brand-new depot located in the heart of the Safari Park. Here you’ll be immersed in the world of wildlife before you even step onto your safari vehicle. Register and relax before your journey, then get whisked away to wild places from across the globe—all from this central location.

_Balloon Safari does not check in at Safari Excursions._

### Flightline Safari

[BOOK NOW](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=6206422)

- Ages 8 & up
- $120 & up per person
- Offered daily
- Approximately 1.5 hours
- Safety/Age Restrictions

**Age Range**: Adults and children **ages 8 and older** only. Children ages 8 to 15 must be accompanied by a paid parent or guardian 18 years or older during the entire Flightline experience. Guests ages 16 to 17 may participate alone, but must have a parent or guardian 18 years or older present at the check-in to sign the liability waiver. All Flightline participants must complete a liability waiver, and understand and follow instructions in English, to participate in Flightline Safari.

**Adult/Child Ratio:** Maximum of 3 children ages 8 to 15 per adult.

**Weight**: Participants must weigh between **60 and 275 pounds** and fit comfortably in the harness.

**Height:**  All participants must meet the minimum height requirement of **48” (4 feet)** tall.

**Footwear**: Secure, closed-toed shoes are required.

**Other Considerations**: No alcohol may be consumed by a participant prior to taking a Flightline Safari.

**Additional Considerations:** Guests must be able to climb and descend stairs without assistance. Accommodations can be made with 24 hour notice minimum. Please contact Reservations Sales at 619-718-3000 for options.

**Change/ Cancellation:** Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted. Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

savannas for views of giraffes, rhinos, and countless other species. Then, experience
breathtaking views of the Safari Park and the surrounding San Pasqual Valley as you "fly" over wildlife
across the expansive plains below!

**Age Range:** All ages.

All Ages programs require at least one adult, ages 18 and older, per tent.

Girl Scouts must book a designated Girl Scout night.

Change/Cancellation: Reservations may be changed up to 30 days before the program and will be subject to a $25 Administrative Change Fee. Less than 30 days, changes not permitted. Cancellations received 30 days before scheduled program are subject to a $50 Cancellation Fee. Less than 30 days, payment is non-refundable.

Spend the night at the Safari Park with your family! Campers of all ages are invited to experience a sleepover that has something for everyone, including walking tours to observe the nighttime activities of wildlife, and morning wildlife presentations.  Due to winter conditions, only Vista and Premium tents are offered on events in January and December.

**What you’ll do:**

- Explore the Safari Park after dark on a guided night hike.

- Learn how the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance is saving wildlife around the globe.

- Stay under the stars in a canvas-style tent.

- Enjoy s’mores around the campfire.

- See some of the Safari Park’s most notable species on a private Africa Tram Safari.

- We’ll take care of your meals: dinner, breakfast, and a snack are all included.

- And more!

Upgrade to a Supreme Roar & Snore Safari package for a whole new level of adventure!  At night, take a Night Vision Safari to view wildlife of Africa and Asia through night vision binoculars. After breakfast, you’ll enjoy reserved VIP viewing of wildlife ambassador encounters. Finally, conclude your overnight experience with a Wildlife Safari into expansive savanna habitats in the back of covered, open-air safari truck for an up-close view of an amazing variety of wildlife. Offered on All Ages events, Adults Only events, and some Exclusive events. Space is limited. Please call 619-718-3000 for availability and pricing.

_Due to the shortened Butterfly Jungle promotion timeline occurring this year, Butterfly Jungle will not be included in any Roar & Snore events in 2026.  Campers who wish to visit Butterfly Jungle in 2026 will need to purchase separate timed Butterfly Jungle entry tickets once they go on sale in the spring.  Butterfly Jungle tickets will need to be timed for either before or after the Roar & Snore experience._

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed._

# TENT OPTIONS

![photo of classic tent](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/Thumb-RoarSnore-classic%402x.jpg)

### Classic Tent

$205\*/person; $65/infant (age 0-2)\*

- 9 x 14-foot interior
- Two bunk cots and one single cots
- Traditional vinyl-covered tent floor
- Sleeps 5

The Classic tents are nestled on the hillside grove under the starry night sky. Dinner, an evening snack, and breakfast are included. Campers must bring their own sleeping bag and pillow.

_\\* Maximum six person occupancy per tent. Single campers pay double occupancy. Admission is separate and required._

![Photo of Vista Tent](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/Thumb-RoarSnore-vista%402x.jpg)

### Vista Tent

$230\*/person; $65/infant (age 0-2)\*

- 9 x 14-foot interior
- Two twin bunk beds and two small single beds
- Traditional vinyl-covered tent floor
- Electrical outlets, fan, and heater
- Sleeps 6

The Vista tents are perched along the perimeter of the campsite where you can enjoy the view of the African savanna. Dinner, an evening snack, and breakfast are included. Campers must bring their own sleeping bag and pillow.

_\\* Maximum six person occupancy per tent. Single campers pay double occupancy. Admission is separate and required._

![Photo of Premium Tent](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/Thumb-RoarSnore-premium%402x.png)

### Premium Tent

$255\*/person; $65/infant (age 0-2)\*

- 12 x 16-foot interior
- One queen bed and one twin bunk bed with trundle
- Electrical outlets, fan, and heater
- Wood floors with area rug
- Bed linens and pillows
- Sleeps 5

The Premium tents feel luxurious with home-away-from-home accommodations. Dinner, an evening snack, and breakfast are included. All bedding is provided.

_\\* Maximum five person occupancy per tent. Single campers pay double occupancy. Admission is separate and required._

# Add-Ons

**Enhance Your Roar & Snore Experience!**

These special add-on Safaris require advance reservations and can be reserved when you call to schedule your Roar & Snore Safari. Our Reservation Sales team is ready to help you plan a perfect stay at the Safari Park.

Call 619-718-3000 for more information and reservations. Age and other restrictions may apply.

![Supreme Roar & Snore](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/safari_tours_supreme_R%26S.png)

### Supreme Roar & Snore

$351 and up\* and per person Ages 8 & up

- Must have a valid Roar & Snore ticket
- Includes Flightline Safari, Night Vision Safari, Reserved Viewing of Wildlife Ambassador Encounters & Wildlife Safari
- Guests ages 8–15 must be accompanied by paid adult; maximum 3 children per adult

Upgrade to a Supreme Roar & Snore Safari package for a whole new level
of adventure! You’ll begin your evening by soaring into camp on our 2/3 mile Flightline Safari zip line. At night, take a Night Vision Safari to view wildlife of Africa and Asia through night vision binoculars. After breakfast,
you’ll enjoy reserved viewing of wildlife ambassador encounters. Finally, conclude your overnight experience with a Wildlife Safari into expansive savanna habitats in the back of a covered, open-air safari truck for an up-
close view of an amazing variety of wildlife.

\*Offered on All Ages events, Adults Only events, and some Exclusive events. Space is limited. Per person Supreme price shown is in addition to the tent price per person. Please call 619-718-3000 for availability and pricing.

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed._

# Ultimate Safari

[All Safaris](https://sdzsafaripark.org/safaris)

![VIP](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/red_dots/safari-dot-vip.svg)

## $760 & up\*

Price details

\*Per person. Admission is separate and required.

\*Admission is separate and required.

## At A Glance

All ages
$760 & up per person
5 hours or 7 hours
Safety/Age Restrictions

Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Special arrangements for children younger than 3 years of age can be made; please inquire when making reservations.

Selfie Sticks are not permitted on this tour and must be stowed away. Some selected tours may have additional safety restrictions.

**Change/Cancellation:** Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted.  Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $200 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to program, payment is non-refundable.

#### A PERSONALIZED ADVENTURE

The ultimate way to experience the Safari Park! Our team of professionals will customize your visit to suit your needs and interests. Looking for a journey to some of the most exclusive areas of the Safari Park? The Ultimate Safari is your key to habitat areas, animal interactions, and the very best in personalized service. Choose either a 5-hour or 7-hour Ultimate Safari, and enjoy exploring the Park with your own personal tour guide. Each Ultimate Safari is tailored to your interests and includes a sit-down lunch.

**This very popular tour requires advance reservations (minimum 72 hours) and is subject to availability. Call 619-718-3000 to reserve your Ultimate Safari. If you prefer to be contacted, please complete** [**this form**](https://sdzsafaripark.org/ultimate-safari-inquiry-form) **. Ultimate Safari tours are priced per person. Admission is separate and required.**

**Please note:** Animal habitat areas are subject to change based on the health and welfare of the animals.

**Customizable:** The Safari experience of a lifetime! All Ultimate Safaris are customized to your specifications. Great for birthdays and other special occasions. Ask us how we can help plan your special day!

_Because our animals and the habitats they occupy are constantly evolving, the photos shown on our website are intended as examples only. Wildlife viewing is subject to availability, and the specific animals or habitats encountered during a tour cannot be guaranteed._

### Deluxe Wildlife Safari

[BOOK NOW](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=spdwls21)

- Ages 6 & up
- $124 & up per person
- Offered daily
- 1.5 hours
- Savanna habitats
- Safety/Age Restrictions

**Ages 6 and older**. Ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by a paid adult. Maximum 3 children ages 15 and younger per adult.

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry; parking is not included.

For the safety of our animals and the comfort of our guests, outside food and beverages, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted. Drinking water in closed-lid containers is recommended.

Wildlife Safaris are an all-weather event, however during periods of inclement weather please call 619-718-3000 to check the status of your tour. The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, animal health, and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you on a later tour.

**Change/Cancellations:** Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted. Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

_Wildlife viewing is subject to change based on availability. Tour route subject to change based on wildlife care needs and weather conditions._

If anyone in your party is unable to transfer or requires the use of a wheelchair or other mobility device during the tour, please call **619-718-3000** to book your experience. This allows us to promptly verify the availability of an accessible cart and space for the mobility device. Wildlife viewing is subject to change based on availability.

Spend even more time with your favorite wildlife! On this 90-minute safari, you’ll venture into habitats representing Africa and/or Asia for up-close views of giraffes, rhinos, and many other species. Enjoy amazing photo opportunities while learning about how caring for wildlife here helps us to conserve wildlife around the world.

If anyone in your party is unable to transfer or requires the use of a wheelchair or other mobility device during the tour, please call **619-718-3000** to book your experience. This allows us to promptly verify the availability of an accessible cart and space for the mobility device. Wildlife viewing is subject to change based on availability.

### Walking with Elephants

[BUY NOW](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=6171751)

- All Ages
- $32 and up
- Select dates
- 1 hour
- Denny Sanford’s Elephant Valley
- Safety/Age Restrictions

**All Ages.** Tickets are not required for 0-2 years old.

A separate admission ticket or membership is required for Safari Park entry; parking is not included.

This tour involves about 60 minutes of walking, on established pathways with moderate slopes. Comfortable attire, walking shoes, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat are recommended.

Strollers and mobility devices are permitted. Guests with mobility considerations should please call **(619) 718-3000** to inform us of their needs.

For the safety of our wildlife and the comfort of our guests, selfie sticks, and tripods (except tripods used as monopods) are not permitted. Snacks and drinks are permitted; closed-lid containers are recommended. Water is recommended.  Guests may be asked to put food and drinks away/aside temporarily in certain wildlife areas.

Restrooms are not available along the tour route. Guests are advised to use the restroom before tour begins.

Service animals are permitted. Some areas may be sensitive or restricted to service animals.

Wildlife viewing is subject to change based on availability.

Walking with Elephants is an all-weather event, however during periods of inclement weather please call **619-718-3000** to check the status of your tour. The San Diego Zoo Safari Park reserves the right to cancel or reroute a tour due to inclement weather, wildlife health, and/or safety concerns. In the event of cancellation, efforts will be made to reschedule you on a later tour.

**Change/Cancellations:** Reservations may be changed up to 3 days before the program. Changes made 3 days or less prior to the program are not permitted. Cancellations received more than 3 days before the scheduled program are subject to a $25 Cancellation Fee. Cancellations made 3 days or less prior to the program, payment is non-refundable.

Perk your ears up for this guided walking tour through the all-new Elephant Valley. Your expert guide will share stories of the elephant herd, highlights from their dynamic habitats, extraordinary plant life, and global conservation work

![Giraffes at the Safari Park](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/default_images/hero-cam-giraffe.jpg)

We look forward to your visit and hope you have a wonderful experience exploring the San Diego Zoo Safari Park. We ask school groups to follow our rules and respect the wildlife and property.

## CHAPERONES

To help prevent any problems, and for the safety of your students, you are required to bring enough adults to assist your group. We recommend a **1:4 ratio**: 1 adult for every 4 students in the group. You are required to have at least one adult for every 10 students. Classes including students with disabilities may bring one adult per student needing assistance. Unsupervised students will be escorted to Park Base.

## LUNCHES

The best option is to have students carry their lunches in their backpacks or purchase food vouchers at the time you make a reservation. If you are bringing your lunches with you, there is a storage area outside of the park at the Log Ring; however this storage area does not lock nor is it monitored.

## PARKING AND ARRIVAL

Parking is free for school and youth groups that book in advance and have a reservation. Simply mention the name of your school at the parking booth. Upon arrival, have your entire group wait at the Log Ring located between RV Parking and Guest Services while the group leader collects their admission tickets. The group must remain in this area until you are ready to enter the Safari Park.

## PAST PROBLEMS

Unfortunately, in the past, a small number of students have been caught vandalizing Park property, swearing at other guests, and harassing the wildlife. Students who are found unescorted will be brought to Park Base, and their group may be asked to leave. Students vandalizing or shoplifting will be prosecuted. Schools will be asked to pay for any damage caused by their students. Serious violations will suspend that school's privilege of visiting the Safari Park for one year.

# Student Discounts

[All Student & Youth Groups](https://sdzsafaripark.org/student-youth-groups)

**Students ages 18 and older: get a 10% discount on membership!**

Students who reside in San Diego County receive a 10% discount on the current price of a San Diego Resident, Resident Premium, Wildlife Protector, or Wildlife Protector Premium membership. Students who reside outside San Diego County receive a 10% discount on the current price of a Wildlife Protector or Wildlife Protector Premium membership. To obtain the discount, students must purchase a new membership in person, and present a valid photo ID and proof of current student enrollment upon their first visit to either park to pick up membership card and coupons.

# Seniors Free

All February Long

# Seniors Free

During the month of February, guests ages 65 and older receive free admission to the San Diego Zoo Safari Park. There’s something for everyone when you visit the Safari Park.

Get up close with your favorite wildlife when you book a special experience from our just-launched Safari Excursions hub. Take an exciting expedition on Africa Tram to spot herds of giraffes and rhinos, then wander among kangaroos and connect with platypuses at Walkabout Australia. Join us for [Journey into the Wild](https://sdzsafaripark.org/attractions/journey-wild) to learn about amazing wildlife from the Amazon to right here in the Southwest, and relax with refreshments on the patio at Kijamii Overlook.

See conservation from a whole new perspective while journeying to different worlds at the Safari Park!

_Guests 65+ must present a valid photo ID at turnstiles for free entry. Parking not included. Special experiences may incur additional cost._

**For more information about Seniors Free, check out our FAQs below.**

**For more frequently asked questions,** [**click here**](https://zoo.sandiegozoo.org/help-center#seasonal-events) **.**

### Seniors Free FAQ

Are seniors really free?

Yes! In February, guests ages 65+ must present a valid photo ID at the entrance to receive complimentary admission. Admission is valid that day only at the Safari Park. Parking is not included.

When is Seniors Free at the Safari Park?

The entire month of February is Seniors Free month at the Safari Park. Guests ages 65 and older with a valid photo ID receive free admission all month long. Parking is not included.

What about parking? Is it free or discounted in February?

No, parking is not free and is paid for upon arrival. General Parking costs $20 per vehicle. Our lot is large, and the walk to the entrance may be significant depending on where you park. We also offer Preferred Parking, which offers closer proximity parking to the entrance for an additional $25–$35, depending on the date.

Accessible Parking: Spaces for disabled placard holders are available but fill quickly during Seniors Free month. The General Parking Fee of $20 does apply for Accessible Parking spots.

Bus/Coach parking is available on a limited basis for $55.

_Certain memberships include parking._ [_Check your membership benefits or upgrade today_](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership) _for this added perk._

What should I expect at the Safari Park?

The Safari Park is a walking safari experience in a large, natural setting. Wildlife live in expansive habitats, and most are reached via pedestrian pathways. On average, you may expect to walk between 2–4 miles during your visit, often over hilly terrain. Comfortable walking shoes, water, sunscreen, and a hat are highly recommended.

Is the park accessible for guests with mobility concerns?

All pedestrian paths are accessible and can accommodate mobility devices. Please reference our Accessibility Guide: [https://sdzsafaripark.org/guests-disabilities](https://sdzsafaripark.org/guests-disabilities) for additional information.

How can I get around the park if I can’t walk very far?

The pedestrian pathways of the Safari Park span 700 acres. Shaded rest stops and dining areas provide good places to take breaks along the way.For our guests with limited mobility, here are a few options to assist you during your visit:

- Accessibility Shuttle with Two Stops: Safari Base Camp (entrance area) and Okavango Outpost (near the Africa Tram). Please be aware that wait times can exceed 30 minutes. Capacity is limited.
  - Please note: We do not offer vehicle transport through pedestrian areas.
- Wheelchair & Scooter Rentals: Available near the entrance on a first-come, first-served basis, and often sell out early. Guests may also bring their own approved mobility device.

Are there other ways to see the Safari Park besides walking?

The Safari Park is primarily a pedestrian environment, but there are several opportunities to enjoy wildlife while taking a break from walking:

- Africa Tram (included with admission): A narrated tour and view of the savanna from the perimeter of the multi-species habitat. The tram boarding area is a 2/3 mile downhill walk from the entrance. Queue wait times can exceed 90 minutes during peak days. Preferred Boarding with a shorter wait time is available for an additional fee.
- Safari Excursions (additional cost, reservations required): Enhance your visit and explore the Park with an expert guide! We recommend the Wildlife Safari to travel in the back of a covered, open-air safari truck into our expansive savanna. Or, consider our Cart Safari or Behind-the-Scenes Safari, which explores the Park by golf cart, but does require some walking.
- Other than these options, the Safari Park is primarily a pedestrian environment.

Can I visit the San Diego Zoo for free instead of the Safari Park?

No, Seniors Free is only valid for a complimentary 1-Day Pass to the Safari Park during the month of February. Senior guests must be ages 65+ and show a valid photo ID at the entrance to enter for free. Parking is not included.

Can I bring a guest with me for free?

Yes, if the guest is ages 65+ and shows a valid photo ID at the entrance during the month of February. Guests younger than age 65 require a valid form of admission or membership.

Can I bring a group of seniors?

Yes, group visits are welcome! Go to the [Contact Us](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/contact?_gl=1%2A1n3z7ex%2A_gcl_au%2AODY2NjE5NjE4LjE3NzAyNjE0NjI.) page to provide your information, and we will be happy to assist you with arranging your visit. Please note the $55 parking fee for bus parking. Bus parking is limited and bus drivers should be prepared to park offsite if our lot is full.

Can I go free multiple times?

Yes, guests ages 65+ with valid photo ID may enter the Safari Park free every day during the month of February. Parking is not included.

If I’m a senior and I have a membership, can I bring someone free in my place?

No. Memberships are nontransferable. Guests must be ages 65+ with a valid photo ID to enter the Safari Park free during the month of February. Guests younger than age 65 require a valid form of admission or membership. Members are welcome to bring a guest using their guest admission coupons.

Are there senior discounts on safari experiences?

No, Seniors Free is only valid for complimentary admission to the Safari Park during the month of February. If you’re a member, [check your member benefits](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/membership) to see your Wild Perks℠ discounts on safari experiences.

# Shopping

[Shop Online at ShopZoo.com](https://shopzoo.com/)

![Safari Outfitters](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SafariOutfitters_thumb.jpg)

### Safari Outfitters

- Location: Nairobi Village

Everything you need to start your day! Candy, snacks, apparel, hats, sundries, and souvenirs are available at this entry/exit shop. Strollers, wheelchairs, and electronic conveyance vehicles (scooters) are available for rent.

![Safari Photos](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SafariPhoto_thumb.jpg)

### Safari Photos

Take home a wild safari photo from one of our roving photographers.

![Plant Trader](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/PlantTrader_thumb_0.jpg)

### Plant Trader

- Location: Safari Base Camp

Choose from garden décor and drought-tolerant plants from our own collection.

![Bazaar](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/Bazaar_thumb_1.jpg)

### Bazaar

- Location: Nairobi Village

Featuring our largest gift selection, the Bazaar includes authentic African artifacts, jewelry, books, home décor, T-shirts, hats, toys, candy, snacks, and souvenirs.

![Rift Gifts](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/RiftGifts_thumb_0.jpg)

### Rift Gifts

- Location: Nairobi Village

We've got hats, candy, snacks, sundries, and souvenirs.

![Macan Market](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/MacanMarket_thumb.jpg)

### Macan Market

- Location: Tiger Trail

Shop for all things tiger, including Tiger Trail merchandise.

![Sheared Sheep Shop](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/ShearedSheepShop_thumb.jpg)

### Sheared Sheep Shop

- Location: Walkabout Australia

Featuring Walkabout Australia merchandise, souvenirs, plush animals, T-shirts, and more.

# Student and Youth Groups

The San Diego Zoo started with a roar in 1916, when Dr. Harry Wegeforth was inspired to create a Zoo for the children of San Diego. This initial inspiration is at the heart of our more than century-long commitment to education, and especially to children.

### Field Trips to the San Diego Zoo Safari Park

**Now Accepting Reservations for the 2026 School Year!**

Thank you for considering the San Diego Zoo Safari Park for your students' next adventure! Reservations for the 2026 school year are now open. Explore a variety of exciting options available for students from San Diego County, Southern California, and beyond—your unforgettable journey starts here!

#### Requirements

- A minimum of 15 participants per group is required.
- A maximum of 150 participants per group, per reservation, is allowed.
- A minimum of 1 adult chaperone, age 21 and older, for every 6 participants is required.
- Reservations are required one month in advance.
- Limit one visit per teacher, per school year.
- Groups must arrive and enter together.

## Summer Camp

Summer Camps at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park are temporarily paused as we create an all-new 2.5-acre Learning Savanna and re-imagine Elephant Valley. We can’t wait to welcome your campers for wild fun in coming years, and invite you to explore summer programs being offered at the San Diego Zoo.

We look forward to welcoming you and your family to the Safari Park—all year long—for one-of-a-kind experiences and life-changing moments among the world’s most incredible wildlife.

# Thank You

On behalf of all us at San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, and our conservation allies worldwide, welcome to our family. We are committed to a world where all life thrives, and this is only possible with you by our side.

As a nonprofit leader in wildlife care, conservation, science, and education, we ally with partners around the world to deliver long-term, high-impact solutions to save species. Your support makes all of this possible—for wildlife, people, and the planet we all share—and we couldn't be more grateful to have you as our newest ally!

![Wild Holidays Select Nights Nov 26 thru Jan 4](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/mustache_hero_image/SP25_AT8141_wild-holidays_web-landing-hero_1920x1067_0.jpg)

Select Evenings November 28, 2025–January 4, 2026

# Wild Holidays

Celebrate the holidays and see the San Diego Zoo Safari Park in a whole new light! Go on an expedition of light and travel through places that glow, shine, and twinkle with holiday cheer. Musical entertainment, festive storytelling, and culinary treats create family fun that gets everyone in the spirit of the season.

**Wild Holidays is scheduled on the following dates: November 28–30; December 19–23; and December 26–January 4, 2026. On Wild Holidays dates, the Safari Park is open until 8 p.m.**

_Wild Holidays activities and entertainment are included with admission tickets or membership; wildlife viewing is limited during this evening event._

## Wild Holidays Map

View the San Diego Zoo Safari Park Wild Holidays map online and plan your visit.

[**DOWNLOAD THE PDF HERE ▸**](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/2025-11/8559_SP25_WildHolidaysMap-Final-WEB.pdf)

## SAFARI BASE CAMP

![Safari Park Radio 197.2 FM](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/sp-radio_web-thumb.jpg)

### Safari Park Radio 197.2

- 4–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Safari Base Camp

The Safari Park’s very own radio station returns with a jolly mix of contemporary and traditional sounds of the season.

![Celebration Tree](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/celebration-tree_web-thumb.jpg)

### Wild Holidays Celebration Tree

- 4–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Safari Base Camp

Experience the fun of a giant Safari Park-themed tree sprinkled with unique wildlife decorations and beautiful holiday lighting.

![Holiday Lights](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/light-up-the-holidays_web-thumb.jpg)

### Light Up the Holidays

- 5 minutes
- Safari Base Camp

The area comes to life as it lights up in a choreographed display with a merry holiday soundtrack.

- Carol of the Bells Medley: **5, 6, 7, and 8 p.m.**
- Jingle Bells and More Medley: **5:30, 6:30, and 7:30 p.m.**

![Bridge of Lights](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SP25_AT8141_wild-holidays-bridge-of-light_web-thumb_668x540_0.png)

### Bridge of Lights

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Safari Walk Bridge, Safari Base Camp

Let your holiday expedition take you through this musical and magical tunnel of light.

![Santa with a child whispering in his ear](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/wild-holidays_santa_web-thumb.jpg)

### Santa

- November 28–30 and December 19–23: Noon–8 p.m.; December 6–7, 13–14: 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; December 24–25: 10 a.m.–3 p.m.
- Safari Base Camp

Have your photo taken and visit with the jolly ol’ elf himself before he travels back to the North Pole.

**On November 28–30 and December 19–23,** Santa will be away at the following times:

- _2–2:15 p.m.: Zoom call with elves._
- _4:15–4:45 p.m.: Toy inventory._
- _6:30–6:45 p.m.: Making a list and checking it twice._

**On December 6–7 and 13–14,** Santa will be away at the following times:

- _11:45 a.m.–Noon: Zoom call with elves._
- _2–2:30 p.m.: Toy inventory._
- _3:45–4 p.m.: Making a list and checking it twice._

**On December 24–25,** Santa will be away at the following times:

- _11:45 a.m.–Noon: Zoom call with elves._
- _1:30–2 p.m.: Preparing to return to the North Pole._

## NAIROBI VILLAGE / AFRICAN WOODS

![Safari Parker](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/safari-parker_web-thumb.jpg)

### 'Twas the Night before Wild Holidays

- 4, 5, 6, and 7 p.m. (20 minutes)
- Village Playground, Nairobi Village

Join adventurer extraordinaire Safari Parker for interactive fun and surprises as they read the original holiday story, _‘Twas the Night before Wild Holidays_, ending in a cheerful, wintery finale.

![Holidays troubadour](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/wild-holidays_troubadour_web-thumb.jpg)

### Holiday Troubadour

- 4:30, 5:30, 6:30, and 7:30 p.m. (30 minutes)
- Village Playground, Nairobi Village

Interact and sing along with our talented acoustic holiday musician that spreads cheer for all to hear.

![Wild Holidays violinists](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/turtle-dove_web-thumb_668x540.jpg)

### Turtle Doves

- 4:15, 5:15, 6:15, and 7:15 p.m. (30 minutes)
- Nairobi Walk, Nairobi Village

This violin duo performs all your holiday favorites in a classical, symphonic style.

![Lantern walkway](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/wild-holidays_nairobi-lantern-walk_web-thumb.jpg)

### Nairobi Lantern Walk

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Nairobi Walk, Nairobi Village

Journey down the illuminated path and experience the lanterns as their lights dance to a musical soundtrack.

![lights on a lagoon](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/enchanted-lagoon.jpg)

### Enchanted Lagoon

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Mombasa Lagoon, Nairobi Village

Mombasa Lagoon becomes even more enchanting when it comes to life with sparkling, flickering, and floating holiday lights, adding seasonal ambience to the beauty of the lighted waterfall.

## TIGER TRAIL and BEYOND

![Wild holidays lighted path](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/spirit-of-the-season_web-thumb.jpg)

### The Spirit of the Season

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Sambutan Longhouse at Tiger Trail, Zuest Woolshed at Walkabout Australia, World Gardens, and Condor Ridge

Experience the magic of the season. These locations are decked out with holiday décor and specially designed lighted trees that make for the perfect family photo opportunity.

![Forest of Color](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/forest-of-color_web-thumb.jpg)

### Forest of Color

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- Arbor Walk

See the forest illuminated in beautiful holiday lights as Condor Valley glistens with seasonal magic.

## WORLD GARDENS

![Baja Garden](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/baja-garden.jpg)

### Baja Garden

- 5–8 p.m. (Continuous)
- World Gardens

Stroll through these incredible Southwest gardens aglow with holiday cheer.

![Guitar and percussion musical duo.](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/sweater-weather_web-thumb.jpg)

### Sweater Weather

- 4, 5, 6, and 7 p.m. (30 minutes)
- Traveling through World Gardens and Walkabout Australia

Enjoy an acoustic performance by this traveling guitar duo as they put their own spin on holiday classics.

## CULINARY OFFERINGS

![Two kids enjoying winter treats](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/SP25_AT8141_wild-holidays-culinary-specials_web-thumb_668x540.png)

- Times vary by location
- Throughout the Park

Tis the season for comfy treats. Holiday merrymaking is thirsty—and hungry—work. There are plenty of scrumptious goodies to enjoy around the Safari Park during this wonderful time of year, including delicious craft cocktails on tap, our satisfying roasted cauliflower salad, and more.

Follow your tastebuds and discover other delectable delights like gooey cookie butter cinnamon rolls, refreshing peppermint bark, a variety of gourmet hot chocolate, and all the flavors of the season.

_Menu subject to change. Guests must be 21 years of age or older with a valid ID to consume alcoholic beverages._

# Wildlife Awareness Days

**Join Us for Wildlife Awareness Days at the Safari Park**

Explore the wonders of wildlife as you connect with your favorite species from across the globe and discover fascinating new ones at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park. Engage with the experts that care for wildlife each and every day and keep an eye out for wildlife talks, activity booths, and other fun activities at select locations on grounds. Every time you visit, you make a difference for vulnerable and endangered wildlife worldwide through our eight Conservation Hubs. See the current list of Wildlife Awareness Days below.

**Looking for even closer connections?**

Some Wildlife Awareness Days offer exclusive Behind-the-Scenes Safaris, so you can experience these incredible species like never before.

[Reserve Your Spot](https://sdzsafaripark.org/safaris/behind-scenes-safari)

Take a look below and check back on Wildlife Awareness Days throughout the year.

**2026 Wildlife Awareness Days:**

January 31st: International Zebra Day

March 7th: World Platypus Day

April 17th: International Bat Appreciation Day

April 26th: International Flamingo Day

May 21st: World Tree Kangaroo Day

May 31st: World Parrot Day

June 12th: National Cougar Day

June 21st: World Giraffe Day

July 19th: World Echidna Day

July 29th: International Tiger Day

August 12th: World Elephant Day

September 5th: International Vulture Awareness Day

September 22nd: World Rhino Day

September 24th: World Gorilla Day

September 26th: World Cassowary Day

October 18th: World Okapi Day

October 24th: World Kangaroo Day

December 4th: International Cheetah Day

September 22, 2022

# World Rhino Day

Join us on Thursday, September 22 at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as we celebrate World Rhino Day and the global conservation efforts you make possible for rhinos around the globe. Come explore the rolling hills of the savanna, home to a herd of rhinos—also known as a “crash”—and discover how the cutting-edge science and care at the Safari Park is helping to save rhinos worldwide. With fun surprises throughout the day, this will be a special experience for the whole family!

![Mother and baby rhino walking. ](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/rhino_day_ally_thumb.png)

### Activity Tables

- Thursday, September 22
- 10 a.m. – 3 p.m.
- Africa Loop Pathway by the Africa Tram, Marker 13

Stop by the activities tables to create a take-home craft, answer rhino trivia, and play in the mud, as you discover more about our conservation projects that help rhinos here in San Diego and around the world.

![Rhino mother and rhino calf touching noses](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/Rhino%20calf.jpeg)

### Part of the Crash

- Thursday, September 22
- 10 a.m – 3 p.m
- Africa Loop Pathway by the Africa Tram, Marker 13

Saving rhinos takes a global alliance—and it all begins with you. Make a wish for rhino conservation and declare yourself an ally for wildlife. You can even get your face painted to show your support.

![Baby rhino stands at the top of the hill](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/rhino_day_watch_thumb.png)

### Behind-the-Scenes: Saving Giants

- Reservation required; space is limited.

Discover what it takes to save giants. This [90-minute journey](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=spkbts21&utm_source=park&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2022wrd&utm_content=rr-text) will take you to areas of the Nikita Kahn Rhino Rescue Center and Elephant Valley that are rarely seen by guests, where you’ll hear firsthand conservation stories about how your support is saving rhinos and elephants around the world.

![Close up of a rhino lookingat camera](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/rhino_day_read_thumb.png)

### Mission: Rhino Rescue!

- Reservation required; space is limited.

In this [Behind-the-Scenes Safari](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=spkbts21&utm_source=park&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2022wrd&utm_content=rr-text)[,](https://tickets.sandiegozoo.org/webstore/shop/viewItems.aspx?cg=webstoresdp&c=spkbts21) you’ll get an inside look at rhino care, conservation work, and the cutting-edge science we’re using to save the northern white rhino. Explore the Frozen Zoo®, the Paul Harter Veterinary Medical Center, and the Nikita Kahn Rhino Rescue Center, and discover how your support is saving rhinos worldwide.

![Baby rhino running](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/rhino_day_read_kids_thumb.png)

### Adopt a Rhino

[YOU CAN HELP](https://sandiegozoowildlifealliance.org/adopt/rhino?utm_source=park&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2022wrd&utm_content=adopt)

Your symbolic adoption helps save rhinos across the globe—including the critically endangered northern white rhino—offering hope for these gentle giants and for other extraordinary wildlife, here in San Diego and around the world.

![Rhino with SDZWA savanna hub logo](https://sdzsafaripark.org/sites/default/files/page_list_item/rhino_day_savanna_thumb.png)

### Be an Ally for Wildlife

[GIVE TODAY](https://secure3.convio.net/sdzoo/site/Donation2?df_id=15650&mfc_pref=T&15650_donation=form1&utm_source=park&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2022wrd&utm_content=ally)

As an ally, you’re supporting wildlife and the planet we all share. Your [monthly gift](https://secure3.convio.net/sdzoo/site/Donation2?df_id=15650&mfc_pref=T&15650.donation=form1&utm_source=park&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2022wrd&utm_content=ally-text)helps fuel our mission, as we create a world where all life thrives

# A Team to Believe In

Our talented, award-winning team will guide you through every step of hosting any type of event in one of our spectacular venues. We strive to offer each client an enjoyable and stress-free planning process. Our attention to detail, creativity, and passion for developing extraordinary events set us apart, and ensure that you will have a fun experience leading to a unique and memorable gathering.

## WE ARE HERE FOR YOU

Whether you’re looking for something wild, exotic, or in between, our amazing Event Coordinators will help you plan the perfect event!
